interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk when anticoagulants are combined with antiplatelet agents.
ACE inhibitors plus potassium-sparing diuretics can cause hyperkalemia.
Certain macrolide antibiotics increase statin levels, raising myopathy risk.
Iodinated contrast media combined with metformin raises lactic acidosis risk in renal impairment.
NSAIDs can reduce the effectiveness of ACE inhibitors and stress the kidneys.
